the data from CDF and BELLE on heavy flavoured mesonic spectra in e+ e− annihilation at energies below the bottom threshold can be fitted to a remarkable accuracy with a next-to-leading-order QCD calculation, including resummation of soft-gluon effects, if a non-pertubative correction to the evolution is included; the data from CERN LEP on D* spectra in e+ + e− annihilation can also be fitted to a good accuracy, provided

(1) the CLEO data on D/D* meson fragmentation spectra can be fitted with a next-to-leading order calculation that includes next-to-leading-log resummation of soft-gluon effects, with a reasonably simple model for the non-perturbatve correction to the initial condition for the perturbative evolution.

the e+e− data on D* fragmentation can be fitted to a reasonable accuracy with the help of a next-to-leading-order QCD calculation, that the fitted fragmentation function does not however represent accurately the D* fragmentation at LEP energies and that the discrepancy is not due to initial-state electromagnetic radiation but rather to large non-perturbatively generated corrections to the fixed-order coefficient functions.
